news.title: Should WoW: Forever Dungeons Let Players Complete Quests in One Run?
news.description: In WoW: Forever, dungeon quests may not guarantee being completed in one clear. Should this be adjusted, or is this better for the game?
news.details:
World of Warcraft: Forever launched with all Classic dungeons, plus brand-new ones. Within those dungeons, quests range from old and iconic ones, such as The Defias Brotherhood, to brand-new ones like Destruction in Deadmines. The question is, should running a dungeon once guarantee that all your quests are completed?
WoW Forever Dungeons Overview
Veteran WoW players are all too familiar with two particular Wailing Caverns quests: Deviate Hides and Smart Drinks, where, unless everyone else in your party has completed them prior, you will not get enough quest items in just one clear of the dungeon to complete your quest, requiring the players to reset the dungeon and go again. In Episode 3 of the WoW Forever podcast, Senior Game Designer Rowan Ryder clarifies that this is indeed intentional.

news.title: Save Gold and Gain Bag Space by Earning Quest Rewards in WoW: Forever
news.description: Looking to upgrade your bags, but are a little tight on gold? Here are some bag upgrades from quests in Forever that should give you a bit more storage space!
news.details:
Bag Upgrade Guide
There are many items that players will want to carry while leveling in WoW: Forever. From consumables that replenish you before the next pull, to quest items that you have to carry around, to items you want to vendor to make some Gold, bag space is a premium, especially in the early levels.
At the start of a character's adventure, players can get 6-slot bags to expand their inventory in the starting area. With four 6-slot bags and the base 20 slots, this totals 42 slots. This sounds like a lot, but this space fills up very quickly when you're picking up everything to sell for money and finishing quests. Players will quickly look to expand their inventory space to carry more items on their adventures, but with competing gold costs on skill upgrades every two levels, and Dual Spec and Mount Training at level 40, gold might be tight.

news.title: An Old SoD Secret Has New Rewards in WoW: Forever
news.description: An old SoD secret has been brought forward into WoW: Forever, and it's got some new rewards compared to what players found before.
news.details:
This week, while most players are still adventuring through the early levels, some have been exploring higher-level dungeons and looking out for signs of secrets and surprises that we found in Season of Discovery. In this case, SeventeenUncles has found that the area in Blackrock Depths that used to host a quest for the Rainbow Generator Toy now has a new Toy available.
Thank you to SeventeenUncles for providing the information in this article.
When you use this toy, you can choose from a list of things to put on your signpost, and it will remain in place for 1 hour, where other players will be able to see it.
And not only that, but you also get Student Fodder and Premo's Poise-Demanding Uniform in the same place. Premo's Poise-Demanding Uniform makes you turn to face your target on use. This shirt had a key role to play in the Seventeen & the Secret Agents Secret in Season of Discovery…

news.title: Dungeon Mobs Now Grant Zero Experience When Highest Player is 13 Levels Above the Creature in WoW: Forever
news.description: In a brand-new change, dungeon mobs will now grant zero experience when the highest-level player is more than 12 levels above the creature, instead of when the mob is grey!
news.details:
Many players were very critical of yesterday's dungeon experience change, with many reports across social media and the forums sharing their personal experience of how these changes affected them. Many players pointed how dungeons have a wide variety of mob levels, and how tanks and healers usually want to be overleveled for dungeons to make for easier dungeon runs, and how this change was excluding them from groups.
Blizzard has clearly heard this feedback, admitted they "missed the mark," and have made another change.
Yesterday, we updated dungeon play so that experience granted by an enemy in an instance is nullified if a high level player is in the group and enemy is trivial to that player. For some dungeons, the new restriction missed the mark because of the overall level range of the enemies in the dungeon.

news.title: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold: New Dungeon in WoW: Forever
news.description: Krol'dok Stronghold is a new dungeon that challenges players in the Level 40-45 bracket in WoW: Forever - take a look at the quests and rewards you'll find inside!
news.details:
Krol'dok Stronghold Dungeon Guide
Our dungeon guide has everything you'll need to tackle this dungeon: where to find it, boss strategies, notable trash, and more. Stay tuned for our Dungeon Journal tool to update as well!
New Dungeon: Krol'dok Stronghold
Krol'dok Stronghold is a level 40-45 Dungeon located in the new zone Riverglades. This is a very large dungeon, as players have infiltrated the capital city of the Krol'dok Ogres, assisted by the Twilight's Hammer and Shadowhide Gnoll Clan of Redridge.
Krol'dok Stronghold Quests
There are a total of 5 quests for Alliance and 4 for Horde. Both have very long chain quests that start in their respective faction quest hubs. Both Horde and Alliance should make sure to have 12 Iron Bars and 4 Thick Leather for the quest: Key Ingredients.

news.title: Dungeon Mobs Grant Zero Experience if Trivial to Anyone in Party in WoW: Forever
news.description: In last night's hotfixes, Blizzard announced that if any party member in a dungeon is too high-level, no one in the party will receive experience.
news.details:
Blizzard recently released a large set of hotfixes to dungeons, quests, NPCs, items, and more. These hotfixes had a change to dungeon experience, where if a mob is trivial to anyone in the group it will grant zero experience. Mobs turn grey when a player is too high-level and the mob is considered "trivial".
While dungeon experience is nerfed in WoW: Forever at 60% of the original values, all experience still helps you level up. Inviting a high-level player to a dungeon can now remove a decent chunk of raw experience points from mob kills across an entire dungeon.
BlizzardKilling enemies in dungeons now awards zero experience to all party members if the level of the enemy is trivial to the level of one or more of the party members.

news.title: New Dungeon Set Transforms Players into an Ogre in WoW: Forever
news.description: Players have discovered an additional bonus to equipping all of the new Krol'dok Battlegear armor from Krol'dok Stronghold in Forever: turning the player into an Ogre!
news.details:
Players have discovered an additional bonus to equipping all of the new Krol'dok Battlegear armor from Krol'dok Stronghold in Forever: Turning the player into an Ogre!
One of the new dungeons in WoW: Forever, the Krol'dok Stronghold, has a new set of gear for Protection Warriors and Paladins with the Krol'dok Battlegear. Some pieces, such as the Krol'dok Warplate Pauldrons, are BoE, while others like the Krol'dok Warplate Helmet are BoP drops from bosses within the dungeon. When players acquire all 5 pieces, not only do they benefit from all the set bonuses, but they also transform into an Ogre after reaching the max stacks from the set bonus!
